Individual Exploratory Analysis — TRANS_HOUR_SIN and TRANS_HOUR_COS

The variables TRANS_HOUR_SIN and TRANS_HOUR_COS jointly represent the complete transaction time using cyclical encoding based on sine and cosine. The original transformation preserves hour, minute, and second information.

decimal hour = hour + minute / 60 + second / 3600

9. Continuous cyclical representation

Each point in the chart represents one distinct time position actually observed in the dataset. The complete transaction time is preserved, including hour, minute, and second. Therefore, observations are not restricted to the 24 integer-hour positions.

Repeated transactions occurring at the same exact HH:MM:SS position share the same cyclical coordinate and therefore overlap at the same point.

A total of 86400 distinct temporal positions are represented in the chart.

10. Temporal step and midnight-boundary validation

Cyclical encoding should preserve temporal proximity across the midnight boundary. The transition from 23:59:59 to 00:00:00 should therefore have the same geometric distance as any other one-second transition.

Mean resultant length interpretation:

Values closer to 0 indicate greater dispersion of observations throughout the daily cycle.

Values closer to 1 indicate stronger concentration around a particular region of the daily cycle.

Circular variance is calculated as:

1 - mean resultant length
